blocks.text: BATANGAS CITY—Magnolia blew out NLEX, 95-81, on Saturday in the latest stop of the PBA On Tour exhibition series at Batangas City Sports Center here. The Hotshots took control from the onset before building a lead that went as high as 25 to defeat the Road Warriors despite the presence of new import Deonte Burton. READ: PBA: Deonte Burton ready to embrace NLEX role without pressure Burton suited up for the first time wearing the No. 23 jersey, giving NLEX the advantage as Magnolia played without import KJ Buffen.
